objs.name: document
objs.description: Paperless managed object whose properties, content, versions, validity, release, distribution, translation and archiving are described.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system with selection of the corresponding document type.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Document properties and metadata are maintained.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A document is released after workflow-supported approval.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: A document is archived or invalidated by revoking authorizations except archive access.

o2e.description: The created object is the document.
The properties maintained belong to the document.
The edited content belongs to the document.
The released object is the document.
The archived object is the document.
